title: Give every Change a flat directory and a permanent URL
outcome: Every Change lives at content/changes/<slug>/ and is served at /changes/<slug>/. Advancing a Change's lifecycle stops renaming anything, so its links cannot go stale.
acceptanceCriteria: Every Change directory is named exactly its slug, with no lifecycle directory and no archive date prefix; the three lifecycle meta.json files are gone and content/changes/meta.json lists index plus the rest.
parseChangeMetadata validates directoryName against the slug and returns href as /changes/<slug>/.
loadChangeCatalog reads one directory; catalog sorting and the archive month grouping still use archivedAt ?? startedAt and produce the same order as before.
createChangesBreadcrumbTree no longer keys off lifecycle folder names; breadcrumbs read Changes > <change> > <page> and every Change page still has a breadcrumb.
Every designModules key is <slug>/design with a matching import path, and check-workflow reports no blueprint-design-module diagnostic.

The surviving internal references are updated: blueprint/src tests and the changes route, the two links in blueprint/content, WORKFLOW.md, and docs/agents/artifact-lifecycle.md. References inside docs/changes/ and docs/specs/ are historical snapshots and stay unchanged.
No link in the built site is dead, checked the same way as S02.
The catalog's three filter buttons, the sidebar's four links, and the ?status= query behave exactly as they did before.
